page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-8 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the c4d server family. It features 8 dedicated virtual CPUs and 31.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a memory allocation of 3.88 GB per core. This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring all storage resources to be attached externally.

The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that compute resources are not shared with other tenants, providing predictable execution times for deployed applications. Because the instance lacks bundled local storage and complimentary public IPv4 addresses, it offers a decoupled resource profile where storage and networking costs are scaled independently based on actual usage.

With a balanced vCPU-to-RAM ratio of approximately 1:4, this server is designed for general-purpose workloads. Suitable use cases include web serving, application hosting, containerized microservices, and moderate database operations that do not require high-performance local NVMe drives or hardware acceleration.
